message.subject: Co-creating a practical classroom technology resource
message.email_body: Finding the right free AI tool for every teacher can instantly reduce administrative burdens. Your video on how a free AI tool can help teachers save time caught our attention. At EDXSO, we work with schools on academic outcomes and sustainable growth. We want to propose an exploratory co-created educational resource about practical technology in schools, which would benefit teachers by simplifying digital workflows. Are you open to a brief conversation?
message.dm: Your video on teacher AI tools caught our attention. Would you discuss co-creating a practical technology resource to help teachers save prep time?
